TYPE OF ENTRIES 🕯

Entry at Open:

Enter the market at the start of the next candle. 

In the example, this means entering at the open of the red (bearish) candle following a green (bullish) one.

Entry at Break:

Enter the market when the price breaks the low of the previous candle. 

The example shows entering as soon as the price drops below the low of the green candle, indicating a possible bearish continuation.

It's useful for traders looking to understand and improve their entry strategies in the forex market.

Who has always dreamed of studying in Oxford, Cambridge, or Edinburgh? 🇬🇧

The UK Future Leader Program 2027 is now officially open for applications! This is a one week international learning program for students, young professionals, and emerging leaders aged 18 to 45, who want more than just a trip abroad. You will study English alongside international students, stay with a local host family, and explore Oxford, Cambridge, or Edinburgh, three of the most iconic learning cities in the world.

It is a real learning experience, built around communication, leadership, and personal growth, in an environment that genuinely pushes you forward.

Here is what you will get from the program:
✔️ Homestay accommodation with a local UK family (breakfast & dinner included)
✔️ English & communication classes with international students
✔️ College visits & city explorations
✔️ Public speaking & leadership sessions
✔️ Real intercultural experience & international network
✔️ Official certificate of participation
✔️ Travel insurance included

Choose your pathway:
📍 Oxford — 21 to 27 March 2027
📍 Cambridge — 4 to 10 April 2027
📍 Edinburgh — 18 to 24 April 2027

Rakaman menunjukkan kepulan asap terhasil berhampiran Istana Kumamoto selepas gempa bumi berukuran 7.1 magnitud melanda kawasan berhampiran bandar tersebut di selatan Jepun.

Kawasan tersebut pernah dilanda gempa bumi dahsyat sedekad lalu yang mengakibatkan kira-kira 260,000 penduduk diarahkan berpindah ke pusat pemindahan, menurut pihak berkuasa.

Setakat ini, tahap sebenar kerosakan akibat gempa masih belum dapat dipastikan. Gempa tersebut dilaporkan menyebabkan bekalan elektrik terputus kepada ribuan kediaman serta merosakkan beberapa jalan di kawasan terjejas.
